The crowd never sees its future; the drama is what the plan does to those who must act inside it.

openingLines: A galaxy spanning empire is dying.
And a man has already calculated the exact century its fall will take.
I mean, Azimov's foundation is not about heroes at all.
It is about a crowd that never sees its own future.
